from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """The beginning cash and cash equivalents balance reported by one company."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/certificate code of the company")
    balance_amount: float | None = Field(description="Beginning cash and cash equivalents balance value")
    balance_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元' (RMB yuan)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the balance figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
